slides.say: Triangle A B C is a right triangle. Given: angle A B C is ninety degrees, A B is twenty centimeters, and B C is twenty-one centimeters. What is A C, in centimeters?

The right angle is at B, and we need the side A C. [short pause] Before we calculate anything, let's look at the choices, because some of them can't be the answer at all. Then we'll find A C exactly, with the Pythagorean theorem.

[short pause] Which side is A C? It's the side across from the right angle, the side that doesn't touch B. So A C is the hypotenuse, and in a right triangle the hypotenuse is always the longest side. So A C must be longer than twenty and longer than twenty-one.
at: So A C is the hypotenuse

slides.say: So choice number three, twenty-one, and choice number four, twenty, are out. From the longest-side rule alone, we know that A C is more than twenty-one. We haven't found its exact value yet.
at: and choice number four, twenty, are out

slides.say: What about forty-one? That's twenty plus twenty-one. Remember, two sides of a triangle together are always longer than the third side. If A C were forty-one, the other two sides would lie flat on it, and there would be no room for a triangle. So choice number one is out too. Only twenty-nine is left, so choice number two is our answer.
at: So choice number one is out too
so choice number two is our answer

slides.say: [pause] Now let's also find A C with the theorem, because in most questions we can't rule out three choices. In a right triangle, leg squared plus leg squared equals the hypotenuse squared. Here the legs are A B and B C, so A B squared plus B C squared equals A C squared.
at: Now let's also find A C

slides.say: Twenty squared is four hundred, and twenty-one squared is four hundred forty-one. Four hundred plus four hundred forty-one is eight hundred forty-one. That's A C squared, not A C itself.

To get A C, we take the root. Which number times itself is eight hundred forty-one? Thirty times thirty is nine hundred, a little too much. Try twenty-nine. Twenty-nine times thirty is eight hundred seventy, and twenty-nine less is eight hundred forty-one. So A C is twenty-nine. A length is positive, so we don't need the negative root.
